cluster.headline: רק 50 ק"מ מתוך 140 ב-15 שנה: החומה בגבול לבנון תקועה בלי תקציב (עמוד הבית) / רק 50 מתוך כ-140 ק"מ: 15 שנה אחרי שיצאה לדרך, החומה בין ישראל ללבנון תקועה (כותרת הכתבה)
cluster.body_note: WebFetch: subscriber paywall (.premium); only subtitle + summary box visible, not full body. Author: חגי עמית. Visible: construction on an Israel-Lebanon border wall section near Metula began April 2012 (~1km built then, ~5m high); original cost estimate (as of ~8 years ago) was NIS 1.7bn; Defense Ministry does not know how it will close its 2026 budget for the project; completion is reportedly no longer discussed. Homepage headline claims only 50 of ~140 km built after 15 years — this ratio/total-length figure not yet confirmed from the article body itself.

primary_source_search.article_access: Paywalled (.premium). WebFetch 2026-11-24 returned headline, subtitle, summary box only; body not readable. No source attribution visible in accessible text.
